LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 CORRELATIVE CONJUNCTIONS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions, part of Strand 3 in Grade 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Which words do we use when making a choice between two things?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify the pattern: use of show... nominal... how/where/who in a text,

2. use correlative conjunctions either...or/neither...nor in sentences,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify the pattern: use of show... nominal... how/where/who in a text,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: The learner’s ability to use technology for learning is enhanced as they search from online

sources for instances in which correlative conjunctions either...or/neither are used in newspapers or magazines.

• Creativity and Imagination: The learner’s ability to create is developed as they create short dialogues using

sentence patterns.

Values:
Responsibility: This is inculcated as the learner observes safety precautions when searching on the internet for

instances in which correlative conjunctions either...or/neither...nor are used.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life skills: Effective communication is enhanced as the learner practises the use of correlative conjunctions in a

variety of sentences and contexts.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The concept of correlative conjunctions is relevant in the learning and use of conjunctions in Kiswahili.
